# KB-HYP3-004

- 엔진(engine): `hyp3`
- 단계(stage): `interferogram`
- 심각도(severity): **FAIL**
- 패턴 검증(pattern_verified): **예** — 업스트림 소스 문자열에서 도출
- 패턴 출처(pattern_source): lib/dynamo/dynamo/exceptions.py (NotStartedApplicationError '{user_id} must request access before submitting jobs', PendingApplicationError "{user_id}'s request for access is pending review", RejectedApplicationError "{user_id}'s request for access has been rejected")

## 패턴 (regex)

```text
must request access before submitting jobs|request for access is pending review|request for access has been rejected
```

## 원인 (Cause)

HyP3 계정의 접근 신청 상태 때문에 작업 제출이 거부되었습니다(신청 전, 검토 대기 중, 또는 거부됨).

_EN_: Job submission was refused because of the HyP3 account's access-application status (not yet requested, pending review, or rejected).

## 조치 (Fix)

HyP3 On Demand(https://hyp3-docs.asf.alaska.edu/)에서 접근을 신청하고 승인될 때까지 기다리세요. 승인 전에는 'wintersar plan'으로 견적만 확인할 수 있습니다.

_EN_: Request access through HyP3 On Demand (https://hyp3-docs.asf.alaska.edu/) and wait for approval. Until then, 'wintersar plan' can still produce the estimate.
